name: 81432 · Ridgway, CO
findings: ZIP 81432 (Ridgway) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 81432 (Ridgway) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 81432 (Ridgway) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
